dedupe_keys.name: virtual water flows and water savings related to international trade in crop animal and industrial products mekonnen and hoekstra 1996 2005

description: These two companion datasets give the water embedded in international trade of crop, animal and industrial products, averaged over 1996 to 2005. The 4TU.ResearchData records say the first holds virtual-water flows related to trade per country and international flows per product category in million cubic metres a year, with a map of national virtual water balances and the largest gross flows; the second holds national and global water savings from trade in agricultural and industrial products per country and per product, with a map of the largest global savings. Both were published in November 2014 by M.M. Mekonnen and A.Y. Hoekstra in the UNESCO-IHE collection, as downloadable zip files (about 9.9 MB and 0.8 MB) holding Excel sheets, TIFF maps and text, under the 4TU general terms of use at no cost. Coverage is worldwide, by country. Caveats: values are ten-year averages from 1996 to 2005 and are modelled, not measured, and the split between green, blue and grey water in these files is not stated on the page read. For simulation they give country-to-country water dependence through trade, to test how droughts in exporting countries pass on to industrial and food supply elsewhere. Related catalogue records include the WaterStat product water footprints and the UN Comtrade database.
